many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until

import numpy as np, json
def f(g):
    a=np.array(g); out=[]
    H,W=a.shape
    n=W//3
    for r in range(H//3):
        rs=[]
        for c in range(n):
            b=a[r*3:(r+1)*3,c*3:(c+1)*3]
            vals=[int(v) for v in b.ravel() if v!=5]
            rs.append(int(max(set(vals), key=vals.count)))
        out.append(rs)
    return out
